questionnaire.title: RCT Contract Notification - Subcontractor Questionnaire
questionnaire.subtitle: Twelve declarations Revenue requires before BC can register the contract on ROS. Answer Yes or No to each. All are required.
questionnaire.missingAnswers: Please answer every question before submitting.

guidance.bannerBody: Revenue uses your answers to set your RCT deduction rate. Answer based on your actual working arrangement - do not pick what sounds better. The result of these questions is reported to ROS and follows you on every payment.
guidance.riskWarning: This answer may indicate that you are not genuinely self-employed. If Revenue classifies your contract as employment-like, your RCT deduction rate can be 35% instead of 0% or 20%. Answer based on your real working arrangement.

questions.notLabourOnly: Are you satisfied that the contract is NOT a labour only contract?
questions.providePlantMachinery: Provide plant and machinery necessary for the job, other than hand tools?
questions.engageOthersOwnExpense: Engage other people to work on the contract at his/her own expense?
questions.agreedPaymentNoOvertime: Receive an agreed contract payment(s) without entitlement to pay for overtime, holidays, country money, travel and subsistence or other expenses payment?
questions.excludedPensionSickScheme: Be excluded from the industry pension and sick pay scheme, if a sole trader?
questions.ownTransport: Organise his/her own transport to and from sites?
questions.costAndAgreePrices: Cost and agree prices for jobs?
questions.ownInsurance: Provide his/her own insurance cover as appropriate e.g. public liability, etc?
questions.freeToChooseMethod: Free to choose the method to be employed in carrying out the work without the direction or control of the site foreman/overseer?
questions.freeToChooseMethodNote: In the construction sector, for health and safety reasons, all individuals are under the direction of the site foreman/overseer.
questions.ownAccountConcurrent: In business on his/her own account and able to provide the same services concurrently to others?
questions.exposedFinancialRisk: Exposed to financial risk including bearing the cost of making good faulty/substandard work and overruns?
